 THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO ISSUE A WRIT  -2-  WP No. 101795 of 2023 IN NATURE OF CERTIORARI OR ANY OTHER APPROPRIATE WRIT,
ORDER OR DIRECTION TO THE RESPONDENTS HEREIN TO RECONVEY/RESTITUTE THE ACQUIRED LANDS CONSEQUENTLY DELIVERING THE POSSESSION OF ACQUIRED LANDS TO THE PETITIONER BY QUASHING THE 4(1) AND 6(1) NOTIFICATION ISSUED UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT,
1894 VIDE NOTIFICATION NO.LAQ.SR-1649 DATED 10.8.1965 PUBLISHED IN THE PART III-11 OF THE OFFICIAL GAZETTE OF MYSORE IN PG NO.3720 DATED 19.8.1965, VIDE NOTIFICATION NO.R.D-52-LAF DATED 26.12.1965 PUBLISHED IN THE PART III-1 OF THE OFFICIAL GAZETTE OF MYSORE IN PAGE NO.2648 DATED 30.12.1965 RESPECTIVELY.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Learned HCGP accepts notice for respondents No.1, 3 and 5.
The captioned writ petition is filed questioning acquisition of the year 1965.
The petitioner is seeking restitution on the ground that State has diverted the land and has failed to utilize the property, for which it was acquired.
2. The claim is found to be stale claim and therefore, captioned writ petition is liable to be dismissed on that sole ground.
3. The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Syed Maqbool Ali Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh1 has held that High Court should not encourage stale claim.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the judgment cited supra, the Hon'ble Apex Court infact cautioned High Courts entertaining the writ petition seeking direction of acquisition and payment of compensation.
In the present case on hand, infact compensation is paid.
Now, the land loser intends to seek restitution, which cannot be entertained.
If the land was acquired in 1965 and the petitioner who is a land loser has received compensation, he cannot seek restitution after lapse of 58 years.
4. Once the land is acquired, it vests in the State free from all encumbrances.
Once the acquisition is completed, land loser becomes non-persona-grata.

Therefore, he has only right to seek Shri Chetan S/O Mallesh Ahtani vs The State Of Karnataka on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199675486/
2 compensation.

entities.text: Shri Chetan S/O Mallesh Ahtani vs The State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The original land owner, however, has no locus as to how his land is used and whether the land is being used for the AIR 2011 SC 2542 purpose for which it was acquired.
If the land vests in the State free from all encumbrances, there cannot be any rider on the power of the State Government to change user of the land.

Therefore, original land owners are not entitled to restoration of possession on the ground that either the original public purpose is ceased to be in operation or the land is diverted to be used for some other purpose.
5. For the reasons recorded above, writ petition stands dismissed as devoid of merits.
